title: DNF spectral family size bound
statement: For a natural number $w$ and a real number $\varepsilon$, define the DNF spectral family size bound to be $\frac{4\bigl(2(20w)^{d(w,\varepsilon)}\bigr)^2}{\varepsilon}$, where $d(w,\varepsilon)$ is the DNF spectral concentration degree at width $w$ and tolerance $\varepsilon$.
